name: vdm-publication-bundle

Also trigger when the user mentions "publication bundle","validation bundle","CRAFT score","BASS score","burden coverage","claim attack","gate check","reviewer notebook","adversarial audit","publication certificate","closure certificate","artifact manifest", "figure standards", "review-ready", or any CF/CFN publication workflow.
